name: Alina Baraz
notes: ⛔ **`bass808` is null, and the register comes straight from the research**: "warm sustained synth-sub with a slow filter envelope, **in the E1–B2 register**, few slides". E1 is MIDI 28 and B2 is MIDI 47, which is the authored `bassline.register` exactly — one of the very few places in this section where the volume states a register rather than an adjective. Inheriting the lane's 808 would have deleted that part, so it is killed. The kit is the entry's downtempo-electronic one: "a soft filtered kick on 1 and 3, a brushed or sampled snare on 2&4 mixed well down, sparse swung 16th hats, and long drumless intros" — a two-anchor kick, `backbeat_24`, a quiet velocity band and an 8-bar intro. "Heavy sidechain and filter automation" has no schema field and is recorded here rather than faked. The vocal is the identifying parameter and the entry says so: "very breathy, very quiet, very high with almost no vibrato, low note-density, long phrases… the whisper timbre is the identifying parameter". ⚠ `confidence` is **low**, mirroring medium-low: "lane position and collaborators sourced; parametric detail is inference". ⚠ Every drum number, the swing amount and the bassline's motion figures are **INFERRED**. ⚠ `session.bpm.mode` is **INFERRED**: the number is not stated in the entry, and it is an authored centre of gravity inside the band the entry does state. ⚠ **`session.keys` is INFERRED.** The entry's Keys line describes the harmonic grammar but names no key centre, so these values and their weights are an authored choice — no key in this set is stated in the research. ⚠ **`chords.harmonicRhythm` gained `syncopated_cell` (2026-08-17, harmony variety floor).** The entry says "minor and modal, static - one m9/m11 sonority or an `i-VI` pair over a 4-bar loop; the harmony functions as a bed for a downtempo-electronic arrangement rather than as a progression". `chordDurationBeats` is the only parameter carrying a loop length, and it was **dead here**: `generators::chords::layout` reads it under `syncopated_cell` alone, which this model did not author — so every generation was one 4-bar hold instead of the documented loop. The sonority itself does not move: over a single-chord family every cell is the same chord re-voiced. The 4-bar loop is the top of the authored [8, 16] cell range. ⚠ Its 2-bar bottom is **INFERRED** and was already in the file; what changed is that something now reads it. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 975/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.2 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "layered analog pads, arpeggiated plucks, harp and bell textures, and chopped vocal samples; her collaborations sit at the R&B/electronic boundary. Melody is very breathy, very quiet, very high with almost no vibrato, low note-density, long phrases, and wide airy multi-tracked stacks — the whisper timbre is the identifying parameter.", and every claim in it still holds after the change. ⚠ **`drums.kick.lockTo808` removed (2026-08-17, 808 gate).** This kit has no 808 — `bass808` is `null` here or in the parent it inherits — and `lockTo808` is the one parameter that says *how much of the kick the 808 follows*, so in this file it described a pairing that does not exist: `generators::drums::bass808` returns on `block.is_none()` before the value is ever read, which makes it provably dead here. Where it was NOT dead was in the artists and producers who extend this kit and author an 808 of their own: they inherited the zero, `kicks.iter().filter(|_| rng.random_bool(0.0))` kept nothing, and their sub lane was silent at every seed — `bass808::every_shipped_model_with_an_808_produces_a_playable_line` reported "no 808 at all" for 35 of them. Removing it restores the engine's documented default of 1.0 for exactly those children and changes nothing here. ⚠ No researched claim moved: this kit's own statement about the 808 is the `bass808: null` beside it, and that is untouched.
